topic.angle: Listening to Mozart does not make you smarter

card.title: The Mozart effect is mostly a myth

body.claim: Listening to Mozart does not make you or your baby lastingly smarter.
body.why: A 1993 study found a brief boost in a spatial reasoning task for adults after listening to Mozart. Later research found little evidence that Mozart specifically makes you smarter, and claims that it boosts babies' development went well beyond the original study.

probes.question: True or false: studies have shown that listening to Mozart makes babies lastingly smarter.
